Grand Theft Auto VI:
Ultimate Edition
The Grand Theft Auto VI: Ultimate Edition amplifies the deepest and most immersive GTA experience with an exclusive collection of premium vehicles, weapons, apparel and action threaded across all aspects of Jason and Lucia’s story.
Vehicles and garages
’95 Grotti Cheetah – Grotti's signature mid '90s sports car and ode to Shore Drive, the ’95 Grotti Cheetah is complete with a minimalist, retro-futuristic livery and available to punctuate later-stage action.
Jason's safehouse vehicles – Switch gears and soak up the sun in an Army fatigue-tinged Dinka Enduro motorcycle or Crest Kayak.
Shitzu Squalo – Perfect for casting in Gambit Bay and reeling in catches of all sorts, this gradient pink and blue Squalo docked at Washington Beach is made open-ocean-ready with an explosives-laden weapons crate.
’67 Vapid Dominator Buggy and garage – A Mud Club monster offering impressive off-road handling for the backwoods of Mount Kalaga and beyond. Conveniently store it at the Paradise Garage in Watson Bay, which features a weapon locker plus a secure place to deposit stolen goods to be fenced.
Weapons
Hawk and Little Morgan revolvers – His and hers versions of this powerful revolver with classic Vice City stylings sourced from the Vercetti Estate, including palm-tree-etched grips, engraved detailing and high-performance scope.
Personalized weapon variants – Personalized sidearms with detailed engravings for Jason's Girardi ES9 pistol and Lucia's Klose K17 pistol.
Looks
Vice City Style – Whether poolside or side by side, Jason and Lucia can look the part with exclusive outfits, hairstyles, tattoos and more.
Goodtime Gear – A capsule collection of apparel and accessories inspired by the Goodtime State’s hit TV show character, Macca the Gator.
Special commission and customs
Ganado Retro Build – Inject some muscle and classic stylings into Jason's well-worn Vapid Ganado low-riding pickup with exclusive mods.
Classic car collection – Track down a variety of abandoned classic and work-in-progress project cars and revitalize them to their former glory in this special commission from eccentric collector and local fixer, Wyman.
Only open for business in the Ultimate Edition
Rideout Customs – Transform vanilla vehicles into magnificent works of art with detailed interiors, exquisite rims, and donk stylings.
Sara's Unisex Salon – Get signature salon styles for both Jason and Lucia, including facial hair for Jason and makeup and nails for Lucia.
Stock 305 – Style various unique and exclusive looks for Jason and Lucia at Stockyard’s premier destination for elevated streetwear.
Electric Fang Tattoo – Choose from over 50 signature tattoos for both Jason and Lucia, all designed by the artist collective FAILE at Stockyard’s most iconic ink bar.
One-Eyed Willie's – Visit Lake Leonida’s storied mod shop, specializing in off-road modifications and hand-painted automotive artistry.

What is Grand Theft Auto VI?
Vice City, USA.
Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them. But when an easy score goes wrong, they find themselves on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida – forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive.
How innovative features enhance Grand Theft Auto VI on PlayStation 5
The power of the PlayStation 5 is on full display with Grand Theft Auto VI, delivering an unmatched experience throughout Jason and Lucia's story. The game is not playable on PlayStation 4.
Tempest 3D audio
Immerse yourself in Leonida's distinct soundscape with the enhanced and highly accurate audio positioning of Tempest 3D Audio, making each unique situation come alive.
Fast loading
Grand Theft Auto VI leverages the PS5’s ultra-high speed SSD, enabling you to experience the expansive world of Leonida with near-instant load times.
Haptic feedback
Responsive vibrations from the DualSense wireless controller's revolutionary haptic feedback will react to your choices and simulate environmental factors all across the sprawling state of Leonida and modern-day Vice City.
Adaptive triggers
The DualSense wireless controller's adaptive triggers provide dynamic resistance throughout the game.
Integrated speaker
The DualSense wireless controller's integrated speaker also offers an extra dimension with featured occurrences and interactions accentuated by remarkable sound effects from the controller – often enhanced by immersive haptic feedback.

Grand Theft Auto VI FAQs
* How do I claim a month of GTA+ at no extra cost for pre-ordering the digital version of Grand Theft Auto VI?
Pre-order GTAVI from PlayStation Store before November 20, 2026.
Once you’ve pre-ordered GTAVI, visit the GTA+ product page .
Follow the on-screen instructions to complete the transaction at no extra cost.
Important: The on-screen instructions will make it clear on what date your one month of GTA+ will continue into a paid monthly subscription. If you do not want your GTA+ subscription to continue after that date, simply visit Subscriptions Management in your account settings to cancel your subscription before the next payment date. ( Cancel a subscription .)
You need to complete these steps by March 31, 2027, to claim the offer.
If you are an existing GTA+ subscriber, the month will be added onto your existing subscription after the offer is claimed.
The GTA+ subscription offer can only be claimed once-per-account, regardless of additional purchases.
Eligible Consumers:
Players who purchase the digital version of either the Standard or Ultimate Edition of GTAVI prior to November 20, 2026.
Meet the age requirements to purchase GTAVI and GTA+.

What is the release date of Grand Theft Auto VI?
Grand Theft Auto VI is released for PlayStation ® 5 and PS5 ® Pro on November 19, 2026.
Will Grand Theft Auto VI be playable on PlayStation®4?
Grand Theft Auto VI will only be playable on PlayStation 5 consoles. It will not be available for PlayStation 4 consoles.
What editions of Grand Theft Auto VI are available?
Please check the latest options at PlayStation ® Store .
Does Grand Theft Auto VI have any multiplayer modes or features?
Grand Theft Auto VI is a single-player experience.
What age rating is Grand Theft Auto VI?
Age ratings for video games vary from country to country, and at the time of writing the age ratings for Grand Theft Auto VI are unconfirmed. However, Grand Theft Auto V was rated M (Mature 17+) by the ESRB in North America and PEGI 18 in Europe, indicating that it is intended for adult players.
Grand Theft Auto games regularly feature profanities, violence, sexual themes and depictions of illegal acts, and are generally not recommended for children. PlayStation accounts can be age restricted using the PlayStation Family App – find out more here .

Grand Theft Auto VI bonus offer for one month of GTA+ terms and conditions
Pre-order or purchase GTAVI by November 19, 2026, and claim one month of the GTA+ subscription. You’ll receive a confirmation email with GTA+ redemption instructions.
After you make the purchase, the month of GTA+ can be claimed by new, lapsed and existing subscribers at a time of their choosing by 31 March, 2027.
Existing GTA+ subscribers can stack the month onto their existing subscription. Stacking is usually not supported by GTA+ on PlayStation Store.
The GTA+ subscription is non-transferable and can only be claimed on the account used to pre-order or purchase the game. Limited to one redemption per account, regardless of additional purchases. After one month, your membership will continue monthly at the regular monthly price until canceled. Cancel anytime.
Ultimate Edition upgrade is not eligible for this offer.
How to claim a Month of GTA+ for pre-ordering or purchasing the digital version of Grand Theft Auto VI
Pre-order or purchase GTAVI from PlayStation Store on or before November 19, 2026. You’ll receive a confirmation email with GTA+ redemption instructions.
Pre order a game
Once you’ve ordered GTAVI, visit the GTA+ product page.
GTA+ product page
Follow the on-screen instructions to complete the transaction at no extra cost.
Important: The on-screen instructions will make it clear on what date your one Month of GTA+ will continue into a paid monthly subscription. If you do not want your GTA+ subscription to continue after that date, simply visit Subscriptions Management in your account settings to cancel your subscription before the next payment date.
Cancel a subscription
You need to complete these steps by March 31, 2027, to claim the offer.
If you're an existing GTA+ subscriber, the month will be added to your existing subscription after the offer is claimed.
The GTA+ subscription offer can only be claimed once per account, regardless of additional purchases.
Eligible Consumers
Players who purchase the digital version of either the Standard or Ultimate Edition of GTAVI on or before November 19, 2026.
Meet the age requirements to purchase GTAVI and GTA+.
All PlayStation Country Stores, excluding Bahrain, China, Kuwait, Lebanon, Oman, Qatar, and the Russian Federation.
Frequently asked questions
What is the release date for Grand Theft Auto VI?
Grand Theft Auto VI is released for PlayStation®5 and PS5® Pro on November 19, 2026.
Will Grand Theft Auto VI be playable on PlayStation®4 consoles?
Grand Theft Auto VI will only be playable on PlayStation 5 consoles. It will not be available for PlayStation 4 consoles.
What editions of Grand Theft Auto VI are available?
Please check the latest options at PlayStation®Store.
Does Grand Theft Auto VI have any multiplayer modes or features?
Grand Theft Auto VI is a single-player experience.
What age rating is Grand Theft Auto VI?
Age ratings for video games vary from country to country, and at the time of writing, the age ratings for Grand Theft Auto VI are unconfirmed. However, Grand Theft Auto V was rated M (Mature 17+) by the ESRB in North America and PEGI 18 in Europe, indicating that it is intended for adult players.
Grand Theft Auto games regularly feature profanities, violence, sexual themes, and depictions of illegal acts, and are generally not recommended for children. Accounts for PlayStation can be age-restricted using the PlayStation Family App.

GTAVI download issue on your PS5 console?
Go to Downloads/Uploads in the control center and select the download.
Select Pause , and then select Resume to restart the download.
If you’re still having issues, select Cancel and Delete to delete the game from the download list.
Find the game in your Game Library and try again.
Find and download games
Check the PlayStation status page. If you see any alerts, wait until the service is up and running and then try again.
PlayStation status
Check that your console has the latest system software installed.
Go to Settings > System > System Software > System Software Update and Settings .
Update PS5 console system software
Check that you have enough free space for the game.
To find the required space for the game, go to your Game Library , select the game > … (more) > View Product .
The required free space appears on the right of the screen.
To check the free space on your PS5 console, go to Settings > Storage .
Manage PS5 console storage space
Find and download games
Start your PS5 console in Safe Mode and select Clear Cache and Rebuild Database to create a new database of all content.
Safe Mode on PS5 consoles
Can't launch GTAVI on your PS5 console?
Has GTAVI been released in your country or region?
Grand Theft Auto VI releases on November 19, 2026, on PS5® consoles. Pre-load for Grand Theft Auto VI starts at midnight local time on November 10, 2026.
Are you using the correct account?
If the account you are using does not own the game, make sure the account that owns the game has turned on Console Sharing and Offline Play on this PS5 console.
Go to Settings > Users and Accounts > Other > Console Sharing and Offline Play .
Select Enable .
Find out more
Has the download failed?
Visit the guide below.
Download issue
Try to restore your licenses
Go to Settings > Users and Accounts > Other > Restore Licenses .
Select the licenses that you want to restore.
To restore a license directly from the home screen or your game library, go to the game, press the options button, and then select Restore License from the menu.
Restore licenses
Missing in-game content?
Ultimate Edition bonuses are available throughout Jason and Lucia’s story, with new bonuses available in each chapter.
What’s included in the Vintage Vice City Pack?
'55 VAPID STANIER: Cruise Shore Drive in this classic sedan and store it just a stone's throw from the glistening sands of Ocean Beach in the Shore Court garage, complete with a weapon locker plus a secure place to deposit stolen goods to be fenced.
OUTFITS AND HAIRSTYLES: Dress for excess with Jason’s effortlessly chic linen suit in vintage pastel, complemented by the cut and coif of the decade of decadence. Show everyone the world is yours in Lucia’s red sequin mini dress and curls.
EXCLUSIVE WEAPON PATTERN: Adorn most guns with a tropical pattern inspired by Tommy Vercetti's iconic palm tree button-up.
The Vintage Vice City Pack is included with all digital purchases of Grand Theft Auto VI made before 11:59:59 PM local time on November 19, 2026.

How innovative features enhance Grand Theft Auto VI on PlayStation 5
The power of the PlayStation 5 is on full display with Grand Theft Auto VI, delivering an unmatched experience throughout Jason and Lucia's story. The game is not playable on PlayStation 4.
Tempest 3D audio
Immerse yourself in Leonida's distinct soundscape with the enhanced and highly accurate audio positioning of Tempest 3D Audio, making each unique situation come alive.
Fast loading
Grand Theft Auto VI leverages the PS5’s ultra-high speed SSD, enabling you to experience the expansive world of Leonida with near-instant load times.
Haptic feedback
Responsive vibrations from the DualSense wireless controller's revolutionary haptic feedback will react to your choices and simulate environmental factors all across the sprawling state of Leonida and modern-day Vice City.
Adaptive triggers
The DualSense wireless controller's adaptive triggers provide dynamic resistance throughout the game.
Integrated speaker
The DualSense wireless controller's integrated speaker also offers an extra dimension with featured occurrences and interactions accentuated by remarkable sound effects from the controller – often enhanced by immersive haptic feedback.
